strategy: Route-aware matched comparisons with family coverage; evaluation feeds the next design question

axes.cap_length: Change cap length against the same core and graft anchor
axes.ring_F: One F at the declared matched ring site
axes.ring_CN: One CN at the declared matched ring site
axes.ring_OMe: One OMe at the same site used for F/CN
axes.ring_Me: One Me at the same site used for F/CN
axes.linker_C2: Change to the two-carbon ether graft anchor
axes.cap_topology: Cyclopropyl versus isopropyl; formula also changes, so not a pure rigidity test
axes.cap_fluorination: Terminal ethyl H replaced by F; cap change, not core-ring substitution
axes.phenothiazine_substitution: 3,7-ring substitution against dimethoxy; second wave is a stress test
axes.core_topology: Declared core comparison; inspect all accompanying structural changes

prospective_rules: Declare exact precursor, product, attachment atom, baseline, design axis and hypothesis before a new batch
Deduplicate exact stereochemical graphs and retain every generation recipe
Run the existing route gate before any new full redox campaign; explicitly scoped method controls are separate
Select within declared family/axis cells with common controls; do not substitute another positional isomer silently
Evaluate all selected cases with the same field-specific QC; retain failures and missing fields
Report matched effects and uncertainty before choosing another axis; never rank by voltage shift alone
Keep base-assisted grafting, capped-site redox and polymer-neighbor quantities distinct
